title: The Kerala State Commission for Minorities Act, 2014
full_text: The Kerala State Commission for Minorities Act, 2014 2014-ലെ കേരള സംസ്ഥാന ന്യൂലപക്ഷ കമ്മീഷന്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20145 Act Number: 5 Enactment Date: 2014-02-13 Act Year: 2014 Short Title: The Kerala State Commission for Minorities Act, 2014 Hindi Title: 2014-ലെ കേരള സംസ്ഥാന ന്യൂലപക്ഷ കമ്മീഷന്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to constitute a State Commission for the comprehensive educational advancement, welfare, protection and empowerment of Minorities and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
